tools.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
schema.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': path to the built .app bundle (e.g. DerivedData/.../Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

url.description: For 'open_url': URL or scheme to open in the simulator.

IMPORTANT: Call read_me before your first show_widget call. Do NOT narrate or mention the read_me call to the user — call it silently, then respond as if you went straight to building the visualization.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

# ERN — Jalon 3 : matériel pour revue unique

**Objet :** validation adversariale du Memory Model (spec 1) après les jalons 1 et 2.
**Contenu :** les trois corpus mis à jour, le contrat du pool de handles, le cadrage de la décision `NoLock`, le registre des obligations inter-spécifications.
**Statut :** matériel de conception, non normatif. Version 2 : corrections de la revue unique de GPT intégrées (contrat du pool, corpus, calendrier, scénarios Weld).

## 0. Règles du jalon 3

1. **Oracle indépendant.** Le verdict attendu d'un cas vient de sa source (clause de MM-02 v0.4, de MM-03.3 v0.3, arbitrage, ou usage déclaré), jamais du comportement des modules. Un cas sans source qui tranche est marqué « à arbitrer ».
2. **Jumeau positif.** Chaque rejet a un jumeau minimal accepté : même séquence sans l'élément fautif. Un rejet qui persiste dans le jumeau est un défaut de construction.
3. **États atteints.** Chaque cas est construit depuis l'état initial par des pas autorisés.
4. **Pas de correction silencieuse.** Un verdict obtenu différent de l'attendu est rapporté avec l'état et le pas en cause.
5. **Classement.** Chaque cas relève de : noyau MM-03 (`N3`), machine MM-02 (`N2`), raffinement (`R`), instance de bibliothèque (`Lib` : arène, pool), ou d'une autre spécification (spec 2, 3, 4, 11). Les cas d'une autre spécification restent des obligations inter-spécifications ; ils ne bloquent pas la clôture du jalon 3.
6. **Couverture.** La colonne « Couvert » indique un témoin déjà produit pendant les jalons 1 et 2, quand il est identifié avec certitude. Le jalon 3 rejoue tous les cas depuis l'état initial, couverts ou non, dans un module de cas séparé.
7. **Cible des corpus.** MM3-H et MM23-H sont encodés au jalon 3 sur les brouillons, sans modifier `MM02`, `MM03` ni `MM23`. MM2-H : ses verdicts sont révisés au jalon 3, mais sa validation exécutable reste une obligation de la reconstruction de référence ; le jalon 3 ne le déclare pas validé.
8. **Écarts connus.** Un cas dont le verdict attendu repose sur une décision non encore appliquée au brouillon (MM23-H15, H16) est encodé avec le verdict obtenu, marqué « écart connu », et inscrit au registre de reconstruction. Il n'est jamais présenté comme réussi.

---

## 1. Corpus MM3-H — discipline d'accès
## 3. Corpus MM23-H — raffinement

La plupart des obligations sont déjà établies par le jalon 2 ; le jalon 3 rejoue chaque cas comme exécution traduite par `simulation`.

| ID | Scénario | Attendu | Couvert (jalon 2) |
|---|---|---|---|
| H01 | Disjonction déclarée sur deux régions partageant une feuille | rejetée par `DDSound` (instanciation par disjonction des feuilles) ; régions déclarées ⇒ octets disjoints | passe 2 (`ddSound_of_layout`, à réénoncer selon la décision 1 du jalon 2) |
| H02 | `reset` d'arène, puis accès par une ancienne autorité de bloc | aucun programme sûr n'y parvient ; MM-02 l'accepterait (allocation vivante) | à énoncer (R4 + `ResetPre`) |
| H03 | Transfert d'un `Vec` dont le stockage possédé est épinglé | aucun pas MM-02 sur le stockage, adresse inchangée | passe 2 (`pinned_address_stable`) |
| H04 | Transfert d'une valeur en place | lecture puis écriture des octets, provenance conservée ; source `Moved` illisible, octets encore initialisés | passe 2 (`transfer_copies`) |
| H05 | `free` d'une racine allouée | un `DeallocStep`, autorité compatible | passe 2 (`freeSound_derived`) |
| H06 | `free` d'un bloc d'arène | impossible : pas une allocation | passe 1 |
| H07 | `alloc` `ok` / `fail` / taille nulle | `AllocStep` / aucun pas / `AllocStep` de taille 0 | passe 1 |
| H08 | `endUse` d'une valeur dont le stockage n'est pas libéré | aucun pas ; allocation vivante (fuite) | passe 1 (`leaked`) |
| H09 | Sortie de cadre | un `DeallocStep` par allocation automatique ; aucun pour le stockage possédé | passe 1 |
| H10 | Stockage statique | allocations jamais désallouées | passe 1 |
| H11 | Lecture d'une feuille `Init` | `ReadStep` `ok` | passe 1 (R1) |
| H12 | `writeShared` | `WriteStep` ordinaire, en séquentiel | passe 1 (R2) |
| H13 | Valeur contenant un pointeur, transférée puis lue | provenance conservée | passe 2 |
| H14 | Pointeur brut d'avant l'appel, utilisé pendant l'appel sur l'empreinte d'un paramètre `Modify` | UB ; aucun programme sûr ne le construit | hors (MM-02.G, spec 3) |
| H15 | Pointeur vers une région vide (`issue []`, `split` vers `[]` puis `store`) | adresse : base de l'allocation de l'ancre effective ; provenance : cette allocation | écart connu : décision 2 du jalon 2 non appliquée au brouillon |
| H16 | Pointeur vers une région dont la tête de liste n'a pas le plus petit décalage | adresse la plus basse des feuilles non vides | écart connu : décision 3 du jalon 2 non appliquée au brouillon |
| H17 | Référence rangée dans une feuille de taille nulle | obligation conditionnelle des specs 4 et 11 (une référence occupe une feuille de la taille d'un pointeur), pas une garantie du raffinement | décision 4 du jalon 2 |

---

## 4. Contrat du pool de handles (instance de bibliothèque, comme l'arène)

1	import Ern.MM23
2	import Ern.MM03.Horrors
3	
4	/-!
5	# MM23-H: adversarial corpus of the refinement (jalon 3, step 3)
6	
7	The cases of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2), §3. Each case is an execution of
8	MM-03 from `S3.init statics` translated by `simulation` (`Ern.MM23`): an `SimRun` built step by step
9	by `srun`, which checks each labelled step (`Step3`) and its obligations (`Oblig`) by `decide`, with
10	parameters fixed once for the run. The layout is computed from the places of the run (`autoL`): the
11	`n`-th root place has the allocation `n` (MM-02 identities are created in that order, K2), its
12	leaves 8 bytes each in index order; the allocation of each root has 8 bytes per leaf, aligned on 8
13	(`autoG`); roots listed in `z` have size zero (K1 (d), D2). Tokens, placement, pointer encoding and
14	the obligations `dec` (accesses aligned on 4 bytes) are those of the pass-2 run `CaseSim`.
15	
16	H15 and H16 rest on decisions 2 and 3 of jalon 2, not applied to the draft: they are encoded with
17	the verdict obtained and marked "écart connu" (material §0, rule 8). H14 and H17 are not encoded
18	(jalon-3 report, (a)).
19	-/
20	
21	namespace Ern.MM23.Horrors
22	
23	open Ern Ern.MM03 Ern.MM23
24	
25	/-! ## Executable translated steps -/
26	
27	section Exec
28	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
29	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
30	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
31	
32	/-- `ok` outcome of a labelled MM-03 step (`Step3`: L1 and L2 envelope included), `none`
33	otherwise. -/
34	def step3exec (s : S3) : Op3 → Option S3
35	  | .derive src q m => if DerivePre s src q m then some (deriveEff s src q m) else none
36	  | .split src rs => if SplitPre k s src rs then some (splitEff s src rs) else none
37	  | .release a => if ReleasePre s a then some (releaseEff s a) else none
38	  | .transfer src dst => if TransferPre k s src dst then some (transferEff s src dst) else none
39	  | .depend q x => if DependPre s q x then some (dependEff s q x) else none
40	  | .enter ps ls => if NoOwner ls ∧ EnterPre s ps ls then some (enterEff s ps ls) else none
41	  | .exit => if ExitPre k s then some (exitEff s) else none
42	  | .read a ls => if canRead3 s a ls then some s else none
43	  | .write a ls _ => if canWrite3 s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
44	  | .writeShared a ls _ => if WriteSharedPre k s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
45	  | .pin p => if PinPre s p then some (pinEff s p true) else none
46	  | .unpin p => if UnpinPre k s p then some (pinEff s p false) else none
47	  | .endUse p => if EndUsePre k s p then some (endUseEff s p) else none
48	  | .free p auth => if FreePre k s p auth then some (freeEff s p) else none
49	  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
50	    if (rootIdx ls).length = 1 ∧ AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s then
51	      some (allocEff s pr ow ls) else none
52	  | .newArena st i => if NewArenaPre s st i then some (newArenaEff s st i) else none
53	  | .issue i via region dst =>
54	    match s.arenas[i]? with
55	    | some ar =>
56	      if IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧ Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧
57	          AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 then
58	        some (arenaSet (issueEff s ar region dst).1 i (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
59	      else none
60	    | none => none
61	  | .reset i via => if ResetAtPre k s i via then some (resetAtEff s i) else none
62	  | .store a p => if StorePre s a p then some (storeEff s a p) else none
63	
64	end Exec
65	
66	theorem step3exec_sound {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
67	    [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone]
68	    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)]
69	    [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)] {s s' : S3} {op : Op3}
70	    (h : step3exec k s op = some s') : Step3 k op s s' := by
71	  cases op <;> simp only [step3exec] at h
72	  all_goals first
73	    | (split at h
74	       · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
75	         first
76	           | exact Guarded.ok hp
77	           | exact ⟨hp.1, Guarded.ok hp.2⟩
78	           | exact ⟨by
79	               obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hp
80	               match hr : rootIdx _, h1 with
81	               | [i], _ => exact ⟨i, rfl⟩, .ok hp.2.1 hp.2.2⟩
82	       · cases h)
83	    | (split at h
84	       · rename_i ar har
85	         split at h
86	         · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
87	           exact .ok har (.ok hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2)
88	         · cases h
89	       · cases h)
90	
91	instance (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [∀ a b, Decidable (C a b)] (ptok : Nat → Nat)
92	    (pv : Nat → Option Nat) (p auth : Nat) : Decidable (FreeCompatInst C ptok pv p auth) :=
93	  match h : pv p with
94	  | some pr => decidable_of_iff (C auth (ptok pr)) ⟨fun hc => ⟨pr, h, hc⟩,
95	      fun ⟨pr', h', hc⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hc⟩
96	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'
97	
98	instance (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [∀ a b, Decidable (C a b)]
99	    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (π : Params) (op : Op3) (pv : Nat → Option Nat) :
100	    Decidable (FreeOblig k C π op pv) := by
101	  cases op <;> unfold FreeOblig <;> infer_instance
102	
103	instance (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [∀ a b, Decidable (C a b)]
104	    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec)
105	    [∀ s o, Decidable (Op2.Dec ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params) (op : Op3) (s3 s3' : S3)
106	    (pv : Nat → Option Nat) (s2 : MM02.State) : Decidable (Oblig k C ObR ObW π op s3 s3' pv s2) := by
107	  unfold Oblig; infer_instance
108	
109	/-- A state of the translation: the MM-03 state, the ghost `provOf` (L4), the MM-02 state. -/
110	abbrev SSt := S3 × (Nat → Option Nat) × MM02.State
111	
112	section Run
113	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
114	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
115	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
116	  (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [∀ a b, Decidable (C a b)] (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec)
117	  (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) [∀ s o, Decidable (Op2.Dec ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params)
118	
119	/-- One translated step (`SimRun.step`): the `ok` MM-03 step, its obligations, then the ghost and
120	the MM-02 state after the associated sequence (K4, L6). -/
121	def sexec (st : SSt) (op : Op3) : Option SSt :=
122	  match step3exec k st.1 op with
123	  | some s3' =>
124	    if Oblig k C ObR ObW π op st.1 s3' st.2.1 st.2.2 then
125	      some (s3', provStep op st.1 st.2.1, exec st.2.2 (assoc π op st.1 st.2.2))
126	    else none
127	  | none => none
128	
129	/-- Translated run of a list of operations, in order of execution. -/
130	def srun (st : SSt) : List Op3 → Option SSt
131	  | [] => some st
132	  | op :: ops => (sexec k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops
133	
134	end Run
135	
136	section RunSound
137	variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
138	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
139	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
140	  {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [∀ a b, Decidable (C a b)] {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
141	  {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} [∀ s o, Decidable (Op2.Dec ObR ObW s o)] {π : Params}
142	  {statics : Statics}
143	
144	/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun`. -/
145	theorem srun_sound : ∀ {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
146	    {s2 : MM02.State} {ops' : List Op3} {st : SSt},
147	    SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → srun k C ObR ObW π (s3, pv, s2) ops' = some st →
148	    ∃ os', SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (ops'.reverse ++ ops) st.1 st.2.1 os' st.2.2
149	  | _, _, _, os, _, [], st, h, he => by
150	    simp only [srun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact ⟨os, h⟩
151	  | ops, s3, pv, os, s2, op :: ops', st, h, he => by
152	    simp only [srun] at he
153	    cases hx : sexec k C ObR ObW π (s3, pv, s2) op with
154	    | none => rw [hx] at he; cases he
155	    | some st₁ =>
156	      rw [hx] at he
157	      simp only [sexec] at hx
158	      cases hs : step3exec k s3 op with
159	      | none => rw [hs] at hx; cases hx
160	      | some s3' =>
161	        rw [hs] at hx
162	        simp only at hx
163	        split at hx
164	        · rename_i hob
165	          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hx; subst hx
166	          obtain ⟨os', h2⟩ := srun_sound (h.step (step3exec_sound hs) hob) he
167	          exact ⟨os', by simpa [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc] using h2⟩
168	        · cases hx
169	
170	end RunSound
171	
172	/-! ## Parameters of the runs -/
173	
174	/-- Root place of `q`: the last element of its chain of parents (MM-03.3.2). -/
175	def rootOf (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Nat := (chain (parentOf P) q).getLastD q
176	
177	/-- Number of root places below `r`: the MM-02 identity of the allocation of the root `r` when every
178	root is laid out in its own allocation, in index order (K2). -/
179	def rootRank (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Nat :=
180	  ((List.range r).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ parentOf P i = none)).length
181	
182	/-- Number of leaves of the root of `l` below `l`. -/
183	def leafRank (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Nat :=
184	  ((List.range l).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ isLeaf P i ∧ rootOf P i = rootOf P l)).length
185	
186	/-- Layout of the runs (K1): a place in the allocation of its root, a leaf at 8 times its rank,
187	8 bytes; size zero for the roots of `z`. -/
188	def autoL (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Layout := fun q =>
189	  if rootOf P q ∈ z then ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 0, 0⟩
190	  else ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 8 * leafRank P q, 8⟩
191	
192	/-- Geometry of the allocation of the root `r` (K2): 8 bytes per leaf, aligned on 8; size zero for
193	the roots of `z`. -/
194	def autoG (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Nat → Geom := fun r =>
195	  if r ∈ z then ⟨0, 0, 8⟩ else ⟨0, 8 * (footprint P r).length, 8⟩
196	
197	/-- Compatibility by equality of tokens (`TokCompat`, as in `CaseSim`). -/
198	abbrev Ceq : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun a d => a = d
199	
200	/-- Parameters of a run whose final places are `P` (`Params`): the layout and geometry above, the
201	tokens, placement, pointer encoding and bytes of `CaseSim`. -/
202	def piOf (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Params :=
203	  ⟨autoL P z, fun f => 100 + f, fun pr => 6 + pr, topPlacement, autoG P z, CaseSim.pe, CaseSim.w⟩
204	
205	theorem piOf_geom (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) (r : Nat) :
206	    0 < ((piOf P z).geom r).align ∧ MM02.Pow2 ((piOf P z).geom r).align := by
207	  simp only [piOf, autoG]
208	  split <;> exact ⟨Nat.succ_pos 7, ⟨3, rfl⟩⟩
209	
210	/-- Initial state of a translation: `S3.init statics`, empty ghost, the MM-02 run of `repr_init`. -/
211	def sinit (statics : Statics) (π : Params) : SSt :=
212	  (S3.init statics, fun _ => none, exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))
213	
214	/-- The MM-03 operation of a labelled one, the bytes of a write dropped. -/
215	def toOp : Op3 → Ern.HandlePool.Op
216	  | .derive src q m => .derive src q m
217	  | .split src rs => .split src rs
218	  | .release a => .release a
219	  | .transfer src dst => .transfer src dst
220	  | .depend q x => .depend q x
221	  | .enter ps ls => .enter ps ls
222	  | .exit => .exit
223	  | .read a ls => .read a ls
224	  | .write a ls _ => .write a ls
225	  | .writeShared a ls _ => .writeShared a ls
226	  | .pin p => .pin p
227	  | .unpin p => .unpin p
228	  | .endUse p => .endUse p
229	  | .free p auth => .free p auth
230	  | .alloc pr ow ls => .alloc pr ow ls
231	  | .newArena st i => .newArena st i
232	  | .issue i via region dst => .issue i via region dst
233	  | .reset i via => .reset i via
234	  | .store a p => .store a p
235	
236	section Cases
237	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
238	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
239	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
240	
241	/-- The parameters of the run `ops` from `S3.init statics`: the layout of its final places. -/
242	def paramsOf (statics : Statics) (ops : List Op3) (z : List Nat) : Params :=
243	  piOf (Ern.MM03.Horrors.run k statics (ops.map toOp)).s.P z
244	
245	/-- The state reached by the translated run of `ops` (or the initial state if it fails). -/
246	def sst (statics : Statics) (π : Params) (ops : List Op3) : SSt :=
247	  (srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW π (sinit statics π) ops).getD (sinit statics π)
248	
249	end Cases
250	
251	section Sim
252	variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
253	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
254	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
255	
256	/-- A successful translated run from the initial state is a `SimRun`. -/
257	theorem simRun_of {statics : Statics} {P : List Place} {z : List Nat} {ops : List Op3}
258	    (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)))
259	    (hlay : NewLayout (piOf P z).L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 (piOf P z).geom
260	      (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))
261	    (hdec : DecAlong CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf (piOf P z) statics))
262	    (h : (srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (piOf P z) (sinit statics (piOf P z)) ops).isSome =
263	      true) :
264	    ∃ os, SimRun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW statics (piOf P z) ops.reverse

570

617	theorem H16 : (∃ os, AllOk Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty os ∧

theorem Exec3.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ops : List Op3} {s : S3}
    (h : Exec3 k statics ops s) : Reachable k statics s := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs ih => exact Reachable.ofStep ih hs.step

/-- Parameters of the refinement fixed once for a whole execution (step 5): the layout, the frame
and provider tokens (K2, L4), the placement (K2), the geometry of the allocation of each root place,
read on its index, the encoding of pointers (L6), the initial bytes of the statics (K3). -/
structure Params where
  L : Layout
  tok : Nat → Nat
  ptok : Nat → Nat
  pl : Placement
  geom : Nat → Geom
  pe : PtrEnc
  w0 : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat

/-- K4, L6: the MM-02 sequence associated with an MM-03 operation from the states `s3`, `s2`. -/
def assoc (π : Params) : Op3 → S3 → MM02.State → List Op2
  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L ls
  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L w ls
  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L w ls
  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps s2 π.L s3.P src dst
  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L s3 a p
  | .issue i _ region dst, s3, s2 => issueOps π.pe s2 π.L s3 i region dst
  | .alloc pr _ ls, s3, s2 =>
    allocOps π.pl (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (some (π.ptok pr)) s2 (rootIdx ls)
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 =>
    allocOps π.pl (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (some (π.tok s3.nF)) s2 (rootIdx ls)
  | .free p auth, s3, _ => deallocOps [rootAlloc π.L s3.P p] auth
  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.tok s3
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- L4: the ghost `provOf` after an operation: `alloc pr _ ls` maps the places it creates to the
provider `pr`; no other operation changes it. -/
def provStep : Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → Nat → Option Nat
  | .alloc pr _ ls, s3, pv => fun r =>
    if s3.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s3.P.length + ls.length then some pr else pv r
  | _, _, pv => pv

/-- K3: the MM-02 operations of the initial state with the parameters `π`. -/
def initOpsOf (π : Params) (statics : Statics) : List Op2 :=
  initOps π.pl π.geom π.tok π.L π.w0 statics

/-- The lock-step translation of an MM-03 execution: the operations (most recent first), the MM-03
state, the ghost `provOf`, the MM-02 operations (in the order of execution) and the MM-02 state.
It starts with the MM-02 run of `repr_init`; each MM-03 step appends its associated sequence. It is
determined by the execution and the parameters. -/
inductive Trans (k : K) (statics : Statics) (π : Params) :
    List Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → List Op2 → MM02.State → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) →
      Trans k statics π [] (S3.init statics) (fun _ => none) (initOpsOf π statics)
        (exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))
  | step {ops : List Op3} {s3 s3' : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
      {s2 : MM02.State} {op : Op3} :
      Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → Step3 k op s3 s3' →
      Trans k statics π (op :: ops) s3' (provStep op s3 pv) (os ++ assoc π op s3 s2)
        (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2))

/-- Every MM-03 execution has a translation. -/
theorem Trans.of_exec {k : K} {statics : Statics} (π : Params) {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    (h : Exec3 k statics ops s3) : ∃ pv os s2, Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh => exact ⟨_, _, _, .init hsh⟩
  | step _ hs ih => obtain ⟨pv, os, s2, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, _, _, ht.step hs⟩

/-- K1, K2: the layout obligation of an operation that creates root places: the new roots are laid
out in fresh allocations, within their geometry (`NewLayout`). -/
def LayoutObl (π : Params) : Op3 → S3 → S3 → MM02.State → Prop
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s3', s2 =>
    NewLayout π.L s3'.P s3.P.length s2.next (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (rootIdx ls)
  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s3', s2 =>
    NewLayout π.L s3'.P s3.P.length s2.next (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (rootIdx ls)
  | _, _, _, _ => True

instance (π : Params) (op : Op3) (s3 s3' : S3) (s2 : MM02.State) :
    Decidable (LayoutObl π op s3 s3' s2) := by
  cases op <;> unfold LayoutObl <;> infer_instance

theorem ReprB.provOf_congr {tok ptok : Nat → Nat} {pv pv' : Nat → Option Nat} {L : Layout}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : MM02.State} (hR : ReprB tok ptok pv L s3 s2)
    (h : ∀ r < s3.P.length, pv' r = pv r) : ReprB tok ptok pv' L s3 s2 :=
  { hR with provTokens := fun r hr hrt => by rw [h r hr]; exact hR.provTokens r hr hrt }

theorem decAlong_readOps {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec} {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {s2 s2' : MM02.State}
    {L : Layout} : ∀ {ls : List Nat}, DecAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2' L ls) →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2' L .read l)
  | [], _, _, h => by cases h
  | _ :: _, ⟨h0, h⟩, _, hl => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl with rfl | hl
    · exact h0
    · exact decAlong_readOps h _ hl

/-- L4: the obligation of the contracts at a `free` of the run: `FreeCompat` is instantiated by
the token of the provider recorded by the ghost `provOf` (`FreeCompatInst`). -/
def FreeOblig (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params) : Op3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → Prop
  | .free p auth, pv => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.ptok pv p auth
  | _, _ => True

/-- The obligations of one step of the run, on the states where it runs: the layout of the new
roots (`LayoutObl`, K1, K2), `dec` along its MM-02 sequence (K5), and `FreeOblig` (L4). -/
def Oblig (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec)
    (π : Params) (op : Op3) (s3 s3' : S3) (pv : Nat → Option Nat) (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop :=
  LayoutObl π op s3 s3' s2 ∧ DecAlong ObR ObW s2 (assoc π op s3 s2) ∧ FreeOblig k C π op pv

/-- An execution of MM-03 with its translation (`Trans`) whose every step meets its obligations
(`Oblig`), and whose initial run meets the layout of the statics and `dec`. The obligations bear on
the states of this execution and its run only. -/
inductive SimRun (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec)
    (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) (statics : Statics) (π : Params) :
    List Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → List Op2 → MM02.State → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      DecAlong ObR ObW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics) →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π [] (S3.init statics) (fun _ => none) (initOpsOf π statics)
        (exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))
  | step {ops : List Op3} {s3 s3' : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
      {s2 : MM02.State} {op : Op3} :
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → Step3 k op s3 s3' →
      Oblig k C ObR ObW π op s3 s3' pv s2 →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (op :: ops) s3' (provStep op s3 pv) (os ++ assoc π op s3 s2)
        (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2))

/-- A `SimRun` is the canonical translation of its execution. -/
theorem SimRun.trans {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
    {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2} {s2 : MM02.State}
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2) : Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh _ _ => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact ih.step hs

/-- A `SimRun` is an execution of MM-03. -/
theorem SimRun.exec3 {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
    {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2} {s2 : MM02.State}
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2) : Exec3 k statics ops s3 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh _ _ => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact ih.step hs

/-- `simulation` (step 5): along every execution of MM-03 from `S3.init statics` within the
envelope of L1 and L2, translated with parameters `π` fixed once for the whole execution, whose
steps meet their obligations (`SimRun`), the MM-02 run starts with the run of `repr_init`, appends
at each step the sequence associated by K4 and L6, has only `ok` outcomes, reaches the state `s2`,
and is in `Repr` with the MM-03 state; the MM-03 state is reached, and the ghost `provOf` is empty
beyond the places. Since every prefix of a `SimRun` is a `SimRun`, this holds at each step. The
remaining hypotheses: `DDSound k` (L7: `ddSound_of_layout`); `stat` (K5); the obligation of the
placement and valid alignments (K2); the compatibility of the frame tokens (K2). `SameSizeAlong`
(L6) is not one: the outcomes and `Repr` hold without it; the copy of the bytes of a `transfer`
holds under it (`transfer_copies`). -/
theorem simulation {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec} {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec}
    {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstatR : ∀ s ac, ObR.stat s ac) (hstatW : ∀ s ac w, ObW.stat s ac w)
    (hpl : PlacementOK π.pl) (hg : ∀ r, 0 < (π.geom r).align ∧ MM02.Pow2 (π.geom r).align)
    (htc : TokCompat C π.tok) :
    ∀ {ops s3 pv os s2}, SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 →
      AllOk C ObR ObW MM02.State.empty os ∧ exec MM02.State.empty os = s2 ∧
      Repr π.tok π.ptok pv π.L s3 s2 ∧ Reachable k statics s3 ∧
      ∀ r, s3.P.length ≤ r → pv r = none := by
  intro ops s3 pv os s2 ht
  induction ht with
  | init hsh hlay0 hdec0 =>
    have := repr_init (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (tok := π.tok) (ptok := π.ptok)
      (provOf := fun _ => none) hsh hpl (fun i _ => hg i) hlay0 (fun _ _ => rfl) hstatW hdec0
    exact ⟨this.1, rfl, this.2, .init hsh, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  | @step ops s3 s3' pv os s2 op _ hs hob ih =>
    obtain ⟨hok, hex, hR, hr, hpv⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hly, hdc, hfc⟩ := hob
    have hwf := (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1
    have hnd := (reachable_invariants hdd hr).2.1.nd
    have hfl := (reachable_fpLeaves_frameOwnedLive hdd hr).1
    have hfo := (reachable_fpLeaves_frameOwnedLive hdd hr).2
    have hr' : Reachable k statics s3' := Reachable.ofStep hr hs.step
    -- the MM-02 side of the step
    have key : AllOk C ObR ObW s2 (assoc π op s3 s2) ∧
        Repr π.tok π.ptok (provStep op s3 pv) π.L s3' (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2)) := by
      cases op with
      | derive => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.derive hs)
      | split => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.split hs)
      | release => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.release hs)
      | transfer => exact r6_transfer hwf hR hs hstatR hstatW hdc
      | depend => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.depend hs)
      | enter ps ls =>
        exact r6_enter hwf hR hpl (fun i _ => hg _) hs.2 (fun i _ => hpv _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
          hly
      | exit => exact r6_exit hwf hfo hR htc hs
      | read => exact r6_read3 hwf hnd hfl hR hs hstatR (decAlong_readOps hdc)
      | write => exact r2_write3 hwf hnd hfl hR hs hstatW hdc
      | writeShared => exact r2_writeShared hwf hnd hfl hR hs hstatW hdc
      | pin => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.pin hs)
      | unpin => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.unpin hs)
      | endUse => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.endUse hs)
      | free p auth => exact r6_free hwf hR hfc hs
      | alloc pr ow ls =>
        obtain ⟨⟨i, hone⟩, hs'⟩ := hs
        have hi : i < ls.length := (rootIdx_mem (k := 0) (by rw [hone]; rfl)).1
        have hR₁ : Repr π.tok π.ptok (provStep (.alloc pr ow ls) s3 pv) π.L s3 s2 :=
          ⟨hR.toReprB.provOf_congr fun r hr => by

theorem simulation_pinned {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}

    (hob : Oblig k C ObR ObW π op s3 s3' pv s2) {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)

/-! ## Real `DDSound` (L7) -/

/-- L7: instantiation of `K.DeclaredDisjoint` by the disjointness of the byte ranges of the leaves
of the two regions: every leaf of `r` and every leaf of `r'` are in different allocations or in
disjoint ranges (MM-02.2, `RangeDisjoint`). -/
def ByteDisjoint (L : Layout) (r r' : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ r, ∀ l' ∈ r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc ∨
    MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len

/-- `ddSound_of_layout` (L7; MM-03.3.8, `DDSound`): when every declaration of disjointness of `K`
implies the byte disjointness of the leaves of the two regions (an obligation of the library that
declares it), and the leaves of a declared region have non-empty ranges, `DDSound` holds. The
non-empty ranges are needed: a leaf of size zero (K1 (d)) is byte-disjoint from itself
(`ddSound_of_layout_needs_size`). -/
theorem ddSound_of_layout {k : K} {L : Layout}
    (h : ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ByteDisjoint L r r')
    (hpos : ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, 0 < (L l).len) : DDSound k := by
  intro r r' hd l hl hl'
  rcases h r r' hd l hl l hl' with e | e
  · exact e rfl
  · exact e (L l).off (Nat.le_refl _) (by have := hpos r r' hd l hl; omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
      (by have := hpos r r' hd l hl; omega)

/-- L7: the instantiation itself, `K.DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint L`, satisfies `DDSound` when
every range is non-empty. -/
theorem ddSound_instance (k : K) {L : Layout} (hpos : ∀ l, 0 < (L l).len) :
    DDSound { k with DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint L } :=
  ddSound_of_layout (fun _ _ h => h) fun _ _ _ l _ => hpos l

/-- Counterexample kept (pass-2 report, (e) 1): with a leaf of size zero, allowed by K1 (d), the
instantiation of L7 declares a region disjoint from itself, and `DDSound` fails. -/
theorem ddSound_of_layout_needs_size (k : K) :
    ¬ DDSound { k with DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint fun _ => ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ } := fun h =>
  h [0] [0] (fun _ _ _ _ => .inr fun _ h1 h2 _ _ => by simp only at h1 h2; omega) 0
    (List.mem_singleton_self _) (List.mem_singleton_self _)

/-- The layout of the counterexample satisfies `LayoutWF` on a state with one static leaf and an
allocation of size zero: the failure is under `LayoutWF`, as L7 states it. -/
example : LayoutWF (fun _ => ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) (S3.init [((none, none, 0), false)])
    (MM02.State.empty.alloc 0 0 0 1 none) := by decide

/-- L7, exactness of the instantiation under `LayoutWF` (K1 (b)): two lists of leaves without
common leaf are byte-disjoint, so an abstraction can declare every pair of regions that share no
leaf. -/
theorem byteDisjoint_of_leaves {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : MM02.State} (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
    {r r' : List Nat} (hr : ∀ l ∈ r, l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hr' : ∀ l ∈ r', l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l) (hd : ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') :
    ByteDisjoint L r r' := by
  intro l hl l' hl'
  by_cases e : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc
  · exact .inr (hlw.disjoint l (hr l hl).1 l' (hr' l' hl').1 (hr l hl).2 (hr' l' hl').2
      (fun h => hd l hl (h ▸ hl')) e)
  · exact .inl e

instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2), in order: 1 the origin is an active authority,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), with effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions; 2 regions within the available footprint
(the origin's footprint where its effective authority is present); 3 regions pairwise disjoint,
structurally (no shared leaf) or by `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8); 4 no region covers an
exclusive right already distributed. O2.5 is not restated: `split` changes neither `D` nor
activity. -/
def SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
  rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) := by
  unfold SplitPre; infer_instance

/-- `split` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (MM-03.3 §3, A6) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A6: end of a temporary access): the
authority becomes inactive. F4: an authority held by a place `q` leaves the anchors of `q` in the
same transition. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (C4): the holder is the current frame, or a place on
which the current frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HasRight`, B2). -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor, except the place that holds `a`, whose anchor
`a` is removed by the release (F4); C4: the authority is derived, an authority

/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (A6), in order: `p` deallocable by the allocator contract
(`Deallocable`) and `auth` a compatible deallocation authority (`FreeCompat`, MM-03.3.8); `p` a
usable owned root (a part is not a unit of storage, and `WF3` gives a part the `dead` flag of its
parent); exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2); no active derived authority on a freed leaf, or
descending from a deactivated authority, held elsewhere and staying live; no usable place
anchored on an authority covering `p`, held within `p`, or whose holder dies; no freed leaf
pinned, statically (`Pinned`) or dynamically, without exception (B6: external obligations end
only through `unpin` under `ExternalDone`). -/
def FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop :=
  k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧ s.Usable p ∧ OwnedRoot s p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (freeS s p).D q,
    FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned]
    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) := by
  unfold FreePre; infer_instance

/-- `free` as a relation (A6). -/
def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)

theorem freeS_get (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : (freeS s p).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
    if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
      { y with active := false } else y := by
  simp [freeS]

theorem freeS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (freeS s p) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [freeS], fun j z hz => ?_⟩
  rw [freeS_get] at hz
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz; cases hz
  | some y =>
    have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
    simp only at e1 e2; subst e1 e2; exact .ok h1 h2 h3 h4

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten; the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged (J1). -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  (s, { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

theorem afp_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).afp j = s.afp j := by simp only [S3.afp, addAuth_lt h]

theorem active_addAuth_iff {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  simp only [S3.Active, addAuth_lt hx]

/-- The disjointness of a new emission from the active ones follows from the authority of
`internal` (MM-03.3 §6; A11): an active block derived from `internal` covering a leaf takes the
effective `Modify` of `internal` away from it. -/
theorem issue_disjoint_redundant {s : S3} {ar : Arena} {region : List Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hai : ArenaInv s ar) (hm : ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify) :
    ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1 := by
  intro e he ha l hl hle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hf, hmd⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.1 e he
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya⟩ := ha; rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
  have hlt := hwf.origin e.2 y ar.internal hy ho
      IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject
  | none : s.arenas[i]? = none → IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the entry
exists and is live (an entry whose `internal` is released cannot be reset), and `ResetPre`. -/
def ResetAtPre (k : K) (s : S3) (i via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.arenas[i]?) (fun ar => s.Active ar.internal ∧ ResetPre k s ar via) False

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (i via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetAtPre k s i via) := by
  unfold ResetAtPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` (D3): `resetEff`, the new logical state written
back. -/
def resetAtEff (s : S3) (i : Nat) : S3 :=
  match s.arenas[i]? with
  | some ar => arenaSet (resetEff s ar).1 i (resetEff s ar).2
  | none => s

/-- `arena.reset` on the entry `i` of the state as a relation (D3). -/
def ResetAtStep (k : K) (i via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
Each verdict is obtained by `decide` on the precondition of the operation concerned. States are
built from `S3.init` by the effects of operations. Classification of each case (kernel,
abstraction with `K` instantiated, out of kernel) is given in the report. -/

/-- Test contracts: `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable` given by lists of
leaves or places, `FreeCompat` by a list of pairs; no declared disjointness; every allocation
satisfiable. -/
def KT (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat)) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, (· ∈ sh), (· ∈ pinned), (· ∈ done), (· ∈ dealloc),
    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ compat, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

section TestContracts
variable (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat))
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable ((KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => instDecidableFalse
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).SharedMutable :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ sh))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).Pinned :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ pinned))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).ExternalDone :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ done))

/-- The bytes of the range of the leaf `l` in `s2`, if its allocation is registered. -/

  (s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map fun a => a.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len

provenance of each initialised byte ("avec les octets lus, provenance comprise"). -/
def bytesOf (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (l : Nat) : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat := fun i =>
  match (s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map fun a => a.bytes ((L l).off + i) with
  | some (MM02.AByte.init v p) => (v, p)
  | _ => (0, none)

D=/var/folders/fx/7gtkr7tx4wdc6t84nz4d15r40000gn/T/tmp.6Vih6eZSoP && cat > $D/t.lean <<'EOF'
import Ern.MM23.Horrors
open Ern Ern.MM03 Ern.MM23 Ern.MM23.Horrors

def isInit : MM02.AByte → Bool | .init _ _ => true | .uninit => false
-- H04: isSome holds also on uninitialised bytes (state after enter, before the write of v)
theorem t_h04a : (rangeBytes (sst K1 [] π1 (r1.take 1)).2.2 π1.L 1).isSome = true ∧
    (rangeBytes (sst K1 [] π1 (r1.take 1)).2.2 π1.L 1).map (·.all (! isInit ·)) = some true := by decide
-- the stronger claim holds on the run
theorem t_h04b : (rangeBytes (exec r1a.2.2 (assoc π1 (.transfer 1 2) r1a.1 r1a.2.2)) π1.L 1).map
    (·.all isInit) = some true := by decide
theorem t_h04c : (assoc π1 (.transfer 1 2) r1a.1 r1a.2.2).map
    (fun o => match o with | .read _ => 0 | .write _ _ => 1 | _ => 2) = [0, 1] := by decide
-- H01: all clauses of SplitPre but the pairwise one hold
theorem t_h01 : r4s.1.Active 0 ∧ r4s.1.ExercisableAt 0 .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ [[1, 2], [2]], ∀ p ∈ r, effective r4s.1 0 p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ [[1, 2], [2]], ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ r4s.1.afp 0 ∧ effective r4s.1 0 p ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ [[1, 2], [2]], ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range r4s.1.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl r4s.1 0 j p) := by
  decide
#print axioms t_h04a
#print axioms t_h04b
#print axioms t_h04c
#print axioms t_h01
EOF
cd /Users/guygouri/Devlab/ernlang/ern/formal && ~/.elan/bin/lake env lean $D/t.lean 2>&1 | tail -12

input.message:
**Verdict: changes.** I found nothing blocking. The runner and the simulation chain are proved in Lean, and every H*, R*_sim and reset_kills_blocks depends only on `[propext, Quot.sound]`. Two case statements are weaker than the "Attendu" or hold for a different reason (H04, H06), and a few minor items follow.

I checked everything in scratch files at `/var/folders/fx/7gtkr7tx4wdc6t84nz4d15r40000gn/T/tmp.6Vih6eZSoP/s.lean` and `t.lean`. Every `t_*` theorem below is decided there with axioms `[propext, Quot.sound]`, and a deliberately false control decide was rejected.

**Findings**

1. **Medium. `Horrors.lean:460`, H06. Cause: formalization error (the reject holds for the wrong reason).**
   - The material expects "impossible : pas une allocation".
   - `FreePre` begins with `k.Deallocable p`, and `K2f := KT [] [] [] [4] [(4, 7)]` does not make 5 deallocable. `t_h06a : ¬ K2f.Deallocable 5` is decided, so the reject follows from the contract alone.
   - The docstring's "even with the storage deallocable" is therefore misleading.
   - The intended reason does hold:
     - with `KT [] [] [] [4, 5] [(4, 7), (5, 7)]`, `t_h06b : FreeStep _ 5 7 r2i.1 .reject` is decided;
     - `t_h06c : ¬ OwnedRoot r2i.1 5` is decided.

2. **Medium. `Horrors.lean:383`, H04. Cause: formalization error (weaker than expected).**
   - The material expects "octets encore initialisés", encoded as `(rangeBytes r1a.2.2 π1.L 1).isSome = true`.
   - `rangeBytes` (`MM23.lean:2020`) is `some` for any registered allocation, so `isSome` does not mean the bytes are initialised.
   - `t_h04a`: after `enter` and before the write of `v`, `isSome` holds while every byte is uninitialised.
   - The intended claim holds: `t_h04b` (every byte of `v` is `.init` after the transfer).
   - "lecture puis écriture" is also not stated, though it holds: `t_h04c`, the sequence is `[read, write]`.

3. **Low. `Horrors.lean:396-397`, H07_ok. Cause: formalization error (weaker than expected).**
   - It states only `length = 1`. It does not say the operation is an `AllocStep`, that it is `ok`, or "of the geometry of the new root" (docstring).
   - `t_h07`: the sequence is one `.alloc` of size 8.

4. **Low. `Horrors.lean:409-410`, H09. Cause: formalization error (weaker than expected).**
   - The material expects "un `DeallocStep` par allocation automatique", stated through `opAlloc`. That function also maps reads and writes to `some prov`, so the statement does not say these are deallocations.
   - `t_h09`: `map opDealloc` gives three deallocations, of the allocations of 0, 1 and 2, each with authority 101.

5. **Low. `Horrors.lean:281` (`sim_of`) and `R1_sim`/`R2_sim`/`R3_sim`. Cause: missing coverage.**
   - `∃ os, AllOk … os ∧ exec … os = s2` leaves `os` existential. No statement ties it to the concatenation of `assoc` sequences.
   - So the per-step "`ok` in the run of R*_sim" claims in the H05, H07_ok and H09 docstrings appear in no statement.
   - `simRun_of` → `SimRun.trans` would pin `os` down.

6. **Low. `Horrors.lean:435-441, 448`, H02 and `reset_kills_blocks`. Cause: missing coverage (your item 6).**
   - `reset_kills_blocks` covers every block, but only in the state right after the reset. Its proof is `exact hpre.2.2.1`, i.e. the second conjunct of `ResetPre`, carried through an effect that leaves `A` unchanged.
   - H02's MM-03 conjuncts do not depend on the reset step:
     - `t_h02d`: block 5 is active at `take 7`;
     - `t_h02b`: it is already inactive at `take 10`, before the `reset`;
     - `t_h02c`: `Read3Step 5 [5] … .reject` already holds there.
   - "aucun programme sûr n'y parvient" would also need persistence across later steps. `KStep.active_back` (`MM03.lean:8085`) provides this for kernel steps but is not used.
   - So the claim rests on one block in one final state, plus an immediate-post-state restatement of `ResetPre`.

7. **Low. `Horrors.lean:642`, H07 `fail`. Cause: formalization error.**
   - The fail step runs under `KNS`, but its state `r7a` was reached under `K0` (rule 3, "États atteints").
   - The conjunct is purely MM-03: nothing in it states "aucun pas" on the MM-02 side.

8. **Nit. `Horrors.lean:242`.** `paramsOf` is defined and never used (grep finds no use).

**Checks with no finding**

- **(2) Each case is a translated execution.** H03 and H04 apply `simulation_pinned` / `simulation` to `R1_prefix` (the `SimRun` of `r1.take 6`) plus `R1_step6`, which is the transfer under test. H01, H07, H15 and H16 call `sim_of` on the run that contains the step. The other cases rely on R1_sim, R2_sim or R3_sim over a full run containing the step; their prefix states come from `srun`, which is deterministic and succeeds on the full run.
- **(3) Runner soundness.** `step3exec_sound`, `srun_sound`, `simRun_of` and `sim_of` are proved without gaps. The `stat` and `TokCompat` arguments are `trivial` and `rfl`.
- **(4) Layout obligations.**
  - `sexec` tests `Oblig` (`Horrors.lean:124`), which includes `LayoutObl` = `NewLayout` for `enter`/`alloc` (`MM23.lean:3266-3271, 3297-3299`). The initial `NewLayout` is checked by `decide` in each `sim_of`/`simRun_of` call.
  - No case is vacuous:
    - H03 uses the dynamic pin (`.inl`);
    - H16 states offsets 0 and 8 with head 5;
    - H07 has a real size-0 root (`z = [2]`);
    - H01's rejected split fails only the pairwise clause (`t_h01`: all other `SplitPre` clauses hold), so the rejection comes from disjointness.
- **(5) Known gaps.** The H15 and H16 docstrings say "écart connu … Not presented as passed" and encode the verdict obtained. The report table also says "écart connu".

I did not check the reconstruction-registry entry that rule 8 requires, or H10's "jamais" beyond liveness at the end of the run.
